coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: FDW employers must pay salary within 7 days, give at least one non-compensable rest day a month (since 1 Jan 2023), and arrange a 6-monthly medical exam (clinics submit via MOM ME portal). No 2026 rule change confirmed. A third-party app, HAH! Help At Home, already offers expiry reminders and payslips (developer and reviews unverified). Candidate C15 (weak). Large buyer count but consumer, low willingness to pay.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Police licence under the Secondhand Goods Dealers Act 2007; application needs URA planning permission for scrap-metal use. Dealers must screen purchases against Police records (a 'RECORD FOUND' result bars the purchase). Same duty as K06 but a different buyer, so listed as a candidate (C09). Dealer count not found.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Pawnbrokers Act 2015: licence conditions (Feb 2024) require monthly returns filed in Excel through the Registry of Pawnbrokers eServices, audited accounts within 4 months of year-end, computerised operations, GIRO participation, UN sanctions screening, and a S$100,000 guarantee. Several pawn POS products exist (PawnSnap, Moneywell, HI-Tech Pawn, PawnSoft, Bravo Store Systems). Candidate C08 (weak). Second-hand goods: K06.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K05 and K06.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Found only owner-side rules: LTA deregistration, scrapping at an LTA-authorised scrapyard, disposal proof within 1 month. No dismantler or parts-dealer licence regime surfaced, and scrapyard counts are unknown. Nothing to list.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: No livestock markets or traders found. The relevant regime is SFA farm licensing (egg and fish farms), covered in C16 (weak). City-state, so thin.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: No search spent (budget). Slaughterhouses are likely few; unverified.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No search spent (budget). No beekeeper register seen in the SFA farm pages; likely negligible; unverified.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: AVS/NParks licenses veterinary centres (S$350) and individual vets (S$80, max 2 years) under the Animals and Birds Act. Conditions include veterinary-manager change notice within 7 days and inspections. Pet cat licensing became mandatory on 1 Sep 2026 (66,000 cats licensed by Jul 2026) through the free PALS portal; that duty falls on households. No vet-sector gap found. Candidate C13 (weak/rejected for the household side).

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: City-state with PUB-supplied water; no well-driller or abstraction licensing surfaced in any result. No search run, so this is a judgement, not a finding.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: NEA licenses general waste collectors in classes A, B, B1 (used cooking oil) and C (sewage, sludge, grease-interceptor waste). Fleet, equipment, driver and crew records are registered in NEA's Integrated Waste Management System; drivers need WSQ certificates. Candidate C14 (weak). Grease-trap side is K07.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: BCA: lift owners need monthly maintenance by a registered contractor, an annual test with a specialist engineer, a Permit to Operate via LEAP, and 5-year records. MOM: registrable pressure vessels need an Authorised Examiner (boilers yearly, air and steam receivers every 2 years). Candidates C06 and C07 (weak).

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: NEA registrable aerosol-generating systems (cooling towers, water fountains): owners register on NEA ePortal, test through a lab accredited by the Singapore Accreditation Council and submit results (bulk Excel upload). Testing frequency and limits unconfirmed. Candidate C05 (weak).

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: SFA requires pesticide-use records on farms; NEA licenses fumigators (Hydrogen Cyanide Fumigation Act) and registers public-health pesticides. General pest-control operator rules were not found. Tiny buyer groups. Nothing worth a candidate; folded into C16.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: MOM employment-agency licence renewal: key appointment holders only, eGuarantee security bond, licence conditions completed within 2 months of in-principle approval. FEDA dormitory licensing has covered dormitories of 7 or more workers since 1 Apr 2023, about 1,600 dormitories. Candidates C01 (promising) and C12 (weak).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: NEA licenses funeral parlours with embalming and crematoria (fines up to S$1,000 and S$2,000), and since Jan 2021 requires NEA-registered contractors for exhumation and niche work in NEA facilities. No private columbarium licensing found. Few operators. Candidate C11 (weak).

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: ROS annual return within 1 month of the AGM, signed online by president, secretary and treasurer; Societies Act amended 2 May 2024 with one-stop filing for societies that are also charities. Charities file an annual report and Governance Evaluation Checklist on the Charity Portal within 6 months of year-end. MUIS Halal Certification Conditions for eating establishments (v4.1) took effect 9 Mar 2026; digital certificates started 1 Oct 2025. Candidates C02 (halal, promising) and C10 (societies and charities, weak). Kosher: not applicable, nothing found.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Lorry speed-limiter mandate (3,501-12,000 kg): phased 1 Jan 2026 to 1 Jul 2027, with next deadlines 1 Jan 2027 and 1 Jul 2027. Traffic Police enforcement operations ran Mar to Aug 2026. Link to bizSAFE renewal from 1 Jan 2026. Installation only by 61 authorised agents (Oct 2025); PSG covers up to 50% for SMEs. Candidate C04 (weak). Taxi and ride-hail operator licences apply to fleets of 800 or more, so not small-operator relevant.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: NEA hawker stall licences need a Food Safety Course certificate and personal operation; hawker assistants must be registered with NEA. No new record rule found. Money changers: K22.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Found: SFA SAFE grading framework (from 19 Jan 2026, about 45,000 licensed establishments; Phase 2 FSMS and Advanced Food Hygiene Officer for Category 1 to keep an A grade, details by 2027), student care centres (330 registered SCFA administrators; six-monthly reporting; income ceiling rises to S$6,500 on 1 Jan 2027), and Massage Establishments Act premises (employee register). Candidates C03 (SAFE, promising), C17 (student care, weak) and C18 (massage, weak). Tattoo studios, driving schools and childminders: not searched. Hunting outfitters: not applicable.
